sl.prio.lead: This is what debt counselling services recommend: first food, rent and electricity. Criminal fines also have priority. Instalments to banks, debt collectors or mail-order companies come last. The app also puts maintenance and health insurance at the top, because otherwise there is a risk of punishment or of losing health insurance benefits.
sl.stufe.1: First: protects your home, electricity, health and freedom
sl.stufe.3: Can usually wait until you have had advice
sl.frist.mahnbescheid: Payment order delivered on {d}. If the claim is wrong or only partly right, object if possible by {frist}. After that, an enforcement order can come at any time.
sl.frist.vollstreckungsbescheid: Enforcement order delivered on {d}. An appeal (Einspruch) is only possible until {frist} (strict deadline). Warning: with the enforcement order, seizure is already allowed now, even if you appeal. Get help immediately.
sl.frist.mahnbescheid.vorbei: The 2 weeks since delivery on {d} have passed. An objection is still possible as long as the court has not yet issued an enforcement order. Act today.
sl.frist.vollstreckungsbescheid.vorbei: According to the app's calculation, the appeal deadline since delivery on {d} has passed. Go immediately with the order and the envelope to a debt counselling or legal advice service. They will check what is still possible.
sl.frist.ungefaehr: Rough calculation: 2 weeks from delivery. If the end falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the deadline ends on the next working day. The app only knows the nationwide public holidays, not those of your federal state. It may therefore show a day that is too early. What counts is the delivery date the postal worker noted on the envelope.
sl.frist.ohneDatum: Add the date from the yellow envelope, and the app will roughly calculate the deadline.
sl.dringend: Urgent: get help from a debt counselling service today and tell them that your home, electricity, account or freedom is at risk.
sl.warum.miete: If you have rent arrears, the landlord can terminate without notice: if on 2 consecutive dates you owe more than one month's rent, or over a longer period 2 months' rent. If you pay everything back at the latest 2 months after the eviction claim is served, or the authority commits to paying, the termination without notice becomes invalid, but only once in 2 years. If the landlord has also given ordinary notice, that termination can remain despite payment. The Jobcenter or social welfare office (Sozialamt) can take over rent arrears, usually as a loan.
sl.warum.energie: The supplier may only cut off electricity or gas if, after a reminder, you are at least 2 monthly instalments and at least 100 € in arrears. The cut-off must be threatened 4 weeks in advance and announced 8 working days in advance. The cut-off is not allowed if it would hit you disproportionately hard (for example a risk to health); write this to the supplier. With the basic supplier (Grundversorgung) you can demand an agreement with interest-free instalments after the threat. If you receive basic income support (Grundsicherungsgeld) or social assistance and a cut-off is threatened, you can apply for a loan at the Jobcenter or social welfare office (Sozialamt). The authority decides case by case whether you get it.
sl.warum.unterhalt: Maintenance secures the living costs of your children or other entitled persons. Anyone who evades the maintenance obligation can commit a criminal offence. For maintenance, more of your wages may also be seized than usual.
sl.warum.geldstrafe: If a criminal fine cannot be collected, a substitute prison sentence is possible: 1 day of detention for 2 daily rates. Ask the public prosecutor's office early about paying in instalments. In many federal states you can avoid detention by doing community work.
sl.warum.kranken: Statutory health insurance: if you are 2 months behind with contributions and do not pay despite a reminder, your right to benefits is suspended. Only the treatment of acute illnesses and pain, benefits during pregnancy and maternity, and early-detection check-ups remain. If you are in need of assistance (Grundsicherungsgeld, social assistance), nothing is suspended. With an instalment agreement you get all benefits again, as long as you pay the instalments on time. Private health insurance: after 2 reminders the contract is suspended and you are insured in the emergency tariff.
sl.warum.bussgeld: If you do not pay an administrative fine and do not show that you cannot pay it, the court can order coercive detention. Tell the authority early that you cannot pay, and ask about instalments.
sl.warum.behoerde: The Jobcenter can offset repayment claims against your ongoing basic income support (Grundsicherungsgeld) (10 or 30 percent of the standard rate). Together it may be at most 30 percent. Check the decision. You can object to a wrong Jobcenter decision within 1 month. The month starts when the decision counts as notified: by post on the fourth day after its date; if it arrived later, from the day it arrived. For other authorities, the deadline is at the end of the decision.
sl.warum.rest: Banks, debt collectors, mail-order companies and mobile phone companies cannot take away your home, electricity or freedom. But they can have things seized if a court has confirmed the claim (for example by an enforcement order). Then the seizure exemption limit and the P-account (P-Konto) protect you. According to debt counsellors, these instalments come last. Do not sign anything and do not agree to new instalments before you have had advice. But keep paying your current phone and internet costs.
sl.hilfe.1: Search by postcode: meine-schulden.de → „Hilfe finden“ (Federal Association for Debt Counselling, BAG-SB). There you can choose a radius and filter by „kostenfrei“ (free of charge), P-account certificates or insolvency counselling.
sl.hilfe.2: Do you receive basic income support (Grundsicherungsgeld, formerly Bürgergeld)? The Jobcenter can arrange or pay for debt counselling if it helps you find or keep work (no fixed entitlement). Ask your contact person.
sl.hilfe.3: Do you receive social assistance or basic income support in old age (Grundsicherung im Alter)? If debt counselling is necessary, the social welfare office (Sozialamt) must point you to it and support you. It should cover reasonable costs if the emergency cannot otherwise be overcome. In other cases it can cover them.
sl.hilfe.4: Recognised services are run by welfare associations (for example Caritas, Diakonie, AWO), consumer advice centres and towns or districts. They are usually free of charge. Be careful with companies that want money in advance or a new loan.
sl.hilfe.5: Is it urgent (eviction, electricity or gas cut-off, detention, account blocked)? Say so on the first call. Then the service can help even before the actual counselling.
sl.druck: Sheet for the debt counselling service
sl.druck.t: An overview to take along, without your name
sl.druck.intro: An overview to take with you. Your name is not on it. But reference and customer numbers are, and they can identify you. Still bring the letters with you.
sl.druck.nurDeutsch: The sheet is in German so that the counselling service can read it.
sl.druck.titel: List of creditors – overview for the debt counselling service
sl.druck.hh: Budget plan: income {e}, fixed expenses {a}, remainder {r}; free before instalments: {f}
sl.druck.hinweis: Own details, not checked. General information, not legal advice. Rules as of: November 2026.
sl.druck.privat: The sheet contains details about your debts. Only give it to the counselling service and do not leave it lying around.
sl.u.1: Proof of your income: pay slip, decisions about pension, unemployment benefit, basic income support (Grundsicherungsgeld), social assistance, housing benefit (Wohngeld), child benefit (Kindergeld)
sl.u.2: An overview of monthly income and expenses (budget plan)
sl.u.3: All letters about the debts, sorted by creditor, newest on top, with dividers, without plastic sleeves
sl.u.4: Contracts, bills, reminders, letters from debt collectors and lawyers, statements of claim
sl.u.5: Court mail: payment and enforcement orders, judgments, seizure orders, summons to disclose assets
sl.u.6: Notices to quit, cut-off threats, maintenance titles, administrative fine notices, decisions on criminal fines
sl.u.7: Acknowledgements of debt and instalment agreements that you have signed
sl.u.8: Don't know who you owe what? You can request a free copy of your data from credit agencies (for example Schufa) (not the paid credit report).
sl.csv.warn: The file contains details about your debts. Only save or share it where others cannot see it. Delete it afterwards.
gs.planen.t: Budget, energy instalment and saving tips
gs.gelb.t: Then a short deadline is usually running, often only 2 weeks
gs.d.geld.frist: There is no fixed deadline. If a fine cannot be collected, a substitute prison sentence follows: 1 day in prison for 2 daily rates (§ 43 StGB). So react to every reminder right away.
gs.d.geld.frist.kurz: No fixed deadline, but prison threatens: 1 day for 2 daily rates.
gs.d.geld.schritt: Contact the public prosecutor's office (Staatsanwaltschaft) right away (the file number is in the letter) and apply for instalments or more time to pay (§ 459a StPO). Also ask whether you can avoid prison by doing community work. Each federal state has its own rules (Art. 293 EGStGB).
gs.d.geld.schritt.kurz: Apply for instalments at the Staatsanwaltschaft right away.
gs.d.miete.brief: Apply for the rent debts to be covered
gs.d.miete.brief.lead: Send the application to the Jobcenter if you receive Grundsicherungsgeld, otherwise to the social welfare office (Sozialamt). The office decides. Usually the money is given as a loan.
gs.d.strom.brief.lead: Your bill shows whether you are in basic supply (Grundversorgung). Keep in the letter what applies to you.
gs.energie.t: Spot back payments early, compare tariffs
pl.abschlag.t: Will you have to pay extra for electricity or gas?
kc.q1: Did you get mail from the court in a yellow envelope?
kc.q2: Are you threatened with prison because you cannot pay a fine?
kc.q3: Has your flat been terminated or do you owe rent?
kc.q4: Has your electricity or gas been threatened to be cut off?
kc.q5: Is your bank account seized or blocked?
kc.q6: Is there not enough money for food this week?
kc.q7: Do you get letters from debt collectors or lawyers?
kc.keins: None of these? Then first get an overview of your debts.
kc.essen: Are you entitled to money? Benefits check
kc.hinweis: This is only an order based on the advice of debt counselling services, not a check of your case.
ip.lead: Tick what your debt collection letter says. The debt collector must give you this information already in the first letter.
ip.1: Who the debt collector is writing for: name and address of the company
ip.2: What the money is for: for a contract, what it was and on which day it was made
ip.3: If interest is charged: how it is calculated (amount, interest rate, period)
ip.4: If collection costs are charged: which costs, how much and why
ip.5: Name, address and e-mail or website of the supervisory authority
ip.6: If the debt collector did not get your address from the creditor: a note saying so
ip.erg.alle: All points are in the letter. This does not yet say whether the claim is correct.
ip.erg.n: Not ticked: {n} of {m} points. Some points only have to be in the letter if they apply (for example interest or collection costs). You can request what is missing in writing:
ip.hinweis: First assessment, not legal advice. The list only shows which details are in the letter. It does not check whether you have to pay.
ip.w1: With an acknowledgement of debt you can usually no longer object later that the claim does not exist, has been paid or is time-barred. The debt collector must tell you this (§ 13a Abs. 4 RDG). Have it checked by a counselling service first.
ip.w1.kurz: Do not sign an acknowledgement of debt.
ip.w2: Before an instalment or deferral agreement, the debt collector must tell you in text form (for example a letter or email) which costs it causes (§ 13a Abs. 3 RDG). Only agree once you know.
ip.w2.kurz: Instalments often cost extra: ask first, then agree.
ip.w3: A payment order (Mahnbescheid) comes from the court in a yellow envelope. You can only object at the court, ideally within 2 weeks (§ 692 ZPO), not with the debt collector.
ip.w3.kurz: Yellow envelope from the court: 2-week deadline.
ms.aufst: Request for a statement of the claim
ms.aufst.t: Who, what for, how much: ask in writing
ms.wider.warn: Only send this if you really do not know the claim or have already paid. If in doubt, have it checked first.
ms.pkonto.t: Request to Familienkasse, Jobcenter or employer
ms.pkonto.lead: The certificate can be issued for example by the Familienkasse, the Jobcenter, your employer or a recognised debt counselling service (§ 903 ZPO). The bank must take it into account from the 2nd business day after you hand it in.
ms.g: To whom? (name of the company or office)
ms.adr: Address (as it appears in the letter)
ms.text: Your letter. You can change everything:
ms.de: The letter is in German so that the office understands it.
ms.ohneAdr: The address is still missing. Copy it from the letter.
ms.hinweis: General template, not legal advice. Mail from the court comes with a deadline: get advice right away.
sb.h.t: Find, prepare, use the waiting time
sb.finden.link: Search for a counselling service near you
sb.finden.link.t: Directory meine-schulden.de: enter your postcode or town
sb.finden.amt: The Jobcenter or social welfare office (Sozialamt) can help
sb.w.lead: Tick what you have already done.
sb.w1: Write to your creditors: I am preparing debt counselling.
sb.w2: Turn your current account into a P-Konto if a seizure threatens.
sb.w3: Open all letters and keep them sorted by creditor.
sb.w4: Enter all debts in the debt list.
sb.w5: Make a budget: what comes in, what goes out?
sb.w6: Take no new loans, promise no instalments, sign nothing.
sb.mappe.lead: Tick what you already have together. Then print the folder and take it with you.
sb.ordner: Take a folder. One divider for each creditor, behind it their letters, the newest on top. Also write down debts with family and friends and always note the full address, no PO box.
sb.ordner.kurz: One folder, one divider for each creditor.
sb.ablauf.lead: This is how it usually goes: a first talk, then securing your home, electricity and income first. After that a budget and a list of creditors, checking the claims and negotiating with the creditors. If no agreement is reached, personal insolvency is possible.
sl.kopf.1: First: rent, electricity and heating, maintenance, fines, health insurance
sl.kopf.2: Then: administrative fines and repayment claims from offices
sl.kopf.3: Last: banks, debt collectors, mobile phone, mail order
ra.empf: We suggest this instalment: {b} a month
ra.uebernommen: The instalment is now in the letter.
ra.ohnePlan: Enter your income, your rent and your food costs in the budget plan. Then we will suggest an instalment.
ra.keine: Right now there is no room for an instalment. Get help from a debt counselling service (Schuldnerberatung).
ra.unpf: According to the garnishment table (Pfändungstabelle), creditors could not seize anything from your income at the moment. So do not offer an instalment before you have seen a debt counselling service (Schuldnerberatung). With rent or electricity debts, you can still face termination of your tenancy or a cut-off: deal with these first. The same applies to a criminal fine (Geldstrafe): ask the public prosecutor (Staatsanwaltschaft) about instalments.
ra.warn: Offering instalments can count as acknowledging the claim. So check first whether the claim is correct.
ra.auft.h: Split across your debts (important debts first)
ra.vor: Rent, electricity and fines come first. Agree the instalment for these directly with your landlord, your energy supplier or the public prosecutor (Staatsanwaltschaft). Banks and debt collectors (Inkasso) come after that.
ra.so.1: Free each month: income {a} minus expenses {b} = {c}
ra.so.2: Buffer for the unexpected: 10 % of income, at least 50 €. For you: {b}
ra.so.3: Instalment: free amount minus buffer, but no more than creditors could seize under the garnishment table (for you about {p}). Only your own income that can be seized is counted, for example wages, pension or unemployment benefit. Child benefit (Kindergeld), child supplement (Kinderzuschlag), housing benefit (Wohngeld), Grundsicherungsgeld, social assistance, maintenance for the children and your partner's income do not count. Rounded down to a full 5 €. For you: {b}
ra.so.4: With several debts, rent, electricity, maintenance, fines and health insurance get the instalment first, then administrative fines and authorities, and banks, debt collectors and mail-order companies last. Within a group we split by the size of the claims and round down to whole euros.
ra.so.5: This is a SoLo rule of thumb, not legal advice. You decide yourself what you offer.
ra.tipp.kurz: Only offer what you can safely pay every month.
ra.tipp: Also think of costs that only come now and then, such as back payments or repairs. Better to start small. You can always increase it later.
